replacements.new: - [x] Derive developmental phase transitions. — ✅ PR #924 / #910 PHASE-1, building on PR #909: on a finite graph and registered nonnegative budget ray, every state's exact entry budget is the least ray scale covering a nondominated path-cost vector. The complete reachable score-argmax correspondence is piecewise constant, can change only at those finite entry thresholds, and preserves ties. Exact replay covers 5,184 worlds and 11,097 threshold events.

- [x] Derive path dependence and hysteresis. — ✅ PR #924 / #910 HYST-1, narrowly lifting PR #898: with symmetric two-form switching burden `kappa`, the exact band is `-kappa < c(B)-c(A) < kappa`; inherited A and B then select different next forms under the same instantaneous ecology, with exact ties at both boundaries. Origin-additive/zero switching and canonical reset erase represented history; universal hysteresis is not claimed.

replacements.old: - [ ] Derive conditions for escaping local developmental traps.
replacements.new: - [x] Derive conditions for escaping local developmental traps. — ✅ PR #924 / #910 TRAP-1: relative to registered operators, targets and budget, deterministic escape exists iff a budget-feasible target path exists; within a finite stochastic horizon, positive escape mass exists iff a positive-probability target path exists. Closed-trap and single-added-edge twins pass, with 1,792 deterministic and 18,144 stochastic exact cases; not all traps are claimed escapable.

replacements.new: - [x] Prove/measure reachability mass for predicted morphologies. — ✅ PR #924 / #910 MASS-1: exact rational finite-horizon Markov dynamic programming reports both endpoint mass and cumulative first-hit mass for preregistered target sets. Distribution normalization, alive-plus-hit accounting and cumulative monotonicity hold, and an independent path-enumeration oracle agrees exactly in 18,144 bounded cases; no stationary or asymptotic conclusion is claimed.
